name: FAQ Answer
description: Answers one real question an owner or prospect asks about Iker: the question on screen, the short answer, the detail, what to do next and the call to action. The vertical Short is the primary cut, with a longer landscape cut.

scenes.title: The question
scenes.guidance: The question as an owner or prospect really asks it, set in the moment they ask it. Put the question itself on screen.

visual.headline: The question, in the viewer's words

scenes.title: The short answer
scenes.guidance: The answer in one or two sentences, backed by a fact. If the honest answer is "no" or "not yet", say so.

scenes.title: The detail
scenes.guidance: The one screen or detail that shows the answer is true. Name labels exactly as Iker shows them, and say when the data is made up.

scenes.title: What to do next
scenes.guidance: What the viewer does with the answer, in one line. No promised outcome.

scenes.title: Next step
scenes.guidance: Where to start, using the site's own call to action.

scenes.title: The question
scenes.guidance: The question as it is really asked, with the everyday situation that makes someone ask it. Put the question on screen.

visual.headline: The question, in the viewer's words

scenes.title: The short answer
scenes.guidance: The answer in two or three sentences, before any detail, so a viewer who stops here still has it. Include the limit if there is one.

scenes.title: The detail
scenes.guidance: How it works, as a decision or a short sequence. Say what stays in the owner's hands.

scenes.title: Where to find it
scenes.guidance: The screen in Iker where the answer lives, named as the product names it. Say the footage uses made-up data.

scenes.title: A closer look
scenes.guidance: Optional second screen: the record the answer is about. Only show states the product really has.

scenes.title: What to do next
scenes.guidance: Two to four things the viewer does with the answer, in order. No promised outcome.

scenes.title: Next step
scenes.guidance: One next step, using the site's own call to action.

scenes.title: Outro
scenes.guidance: Leave empty: brand outro without narration.
